P184.gut: He looks very kind, like he would be easy to talk to and very jolly. A grandfatherly man.

P185.gut: She looks very polite and modest. I see she has a cross and likes things neat, so I think we would get on.

P186.gut: He looks a little bit tired or perhaps bored. He reminds me of my son when he is working too hard.

P187.gut: He looks very professional and organized with his files. A very reliable young man, I think.

P188.gut: She reminds me of some of the ladies at church. She looks quiet but very sensible and hard-working.
